assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A single production sprite for a compact top-down roguelike. Image 1 is a STYLE reference: match its chunky shapes and low detail. Slight front/top view, true transparent background. Hard square pixels, broad planes, dark outline, about 12 flat colors, 2 shades per material. No gradients, glow, antialiasing, fine texture, tiny knobs, background, people, labels or text. Designed to survive very low resolution. Arch opening is entirely transparent from arch down to bottom edge. No door leaves, no floor, no threshold. 48x24 logical pixel design; practical little park entrance, not grand fantasy architecture.
